message_feature: Message implies what the recipient must admit, signal, risk or expose in order to respond
perceived_social_meaning: 'If I take this up, what will people conclude about me, and who will find out?'
appraisal: Anticipated social and identity accounting; appraisal of audience, reversibility and visibility
psychological_mechanism: Reduced anticipated shame, malu, gengsi and family-stigma exposure; preserved standing
emotional_response: Relief; safety; reduced defensiveness; NOT necessarily strong emotion
relational_response: Communicator is experienced as safe rather than demanding
behavioural_possibility: Low-threshold action becomes possible (reading, saving, attending, asking a question)
key_moderators: Public vs private visibility; peer norms; family stigma; identity centrality; severity; platform
failure_mode: Backfires if 'low pressure' becomes vagueness - no clear next step, or a promise of anonymity the service cannot keep

message_feature: Concrete, bounded, performable next step attributed to the recipient
perceived_social_meaning: 'There is something I can actually do, and it is small enough to do'
appraisal: Efficacy appraisal; reduced helplessness; internal locus restored without blame
emotional_response: Motivation; calm; mild pride; relief from paralysis
relational_response: Communicator is experienced as useful rather than merely sympathetic
behavioural_possibility: Costly or effortful behaviour becomes more likely (the petition-signature profile)
key_moderators: Whether the step is genuinely available; structural barriers; severity; prior failed attempts
male_specificity_class: GENERAL (male-relevant via norms that penalise visible helplessness)
failure_mode: Backfires as victim-blaming when structural barriers (cost, distance, queues) make the step unavailable - the manosphere's discipline-only failure mode

message_feature: Named categories, sequences, scripts, thresholds, honest 'here is what we know and do not know'
perceived_social_meaning: 'This is intelligible; someone has a map'
appraisal: Cognitive closure need; ambiguity is resolved
psychological_mechanism: Reduced anxiety of not knowing; orientation
emotional_response: Curiosity; calm; sometimes relief
relational_response: Communicator gains epistemic authority
behavioural_possibility: Willingness to take a first step; willingness to keep reading
key_moderators: Topic tractability; audience literacy; whether the certainty offered is honest
failure_mode: Backfires as FALSE CERTAINTY - the exact mechanism the manosphere exploits. Calibrated structure, not totalising rules

message_feature: First-person plural rooted in a real shared identity, setting or activity; visible peers doing the same thing
perceived_social_meaning: 'People like me are here, and this is a place I already belong'
appraisal: Self-categorisation; group prototypicality; normative fit
psychological_mechanism: Social identity affirmation; reduced deviance risk
emotional_response: Warmth; recognition; sometimes pride
relational_response: Communicator becomes an insider rather than an institution
behavioural_possibility: Attendance, participation, sustained engagement
key_moderators: Whether the shared identity is genuine or cosmetic; whether the group's norms are supportive or policing
failure_mode: Backfires as fake brotherhood when 'kita' is asserted without a real shared identity, and as norm policing when the in-group enforces stoicism

message_feature: Accurate naming of a difficulty the recipient believes is unspoken, WITHOUT supplying a culprit
perceived_social_meaning: 'They have described my situation correctly and they did not need an enemy to do it'
appraisal: Epistemic and emotional acknowledgement; reduced isolation of experience
emotional_response: Relief; being seen; sometimes grief surfacing safely
relational_response: Trust in the communicator's accuracy
behavioural_possibility: Willingness to hear what comes next
key_moderators: Accuracy of the description; whether validation slides into grievance amplification
failure_mode: Backfires as grievance amplification: validating the DIFFICULTY is legitimate, validating a false EXPLANATION of who caused it is not

message_feature: Choice-preserving syntax: can/could/may, options, invitation, explicit permission to decline
perceived_social_meaning: 'They are not trying to control me'
appraisal: Freedom-threat appraisal; persuasion-knowledge activation
emotional_response: Absence of anger and counterarguing; measured openness
relational_response: Communicator is not experienced as an authority imposing on the recipient
behavioural_possibility: Higher acceptance of the same substantive recommendation
key_moderators: Prior autonomy sensitivity; source legitimacy; urgency (crisis narrows this)
failure_mode: Backfires when a genuine emergency needs unambiguous instruction; autonomy-preserving hedging is wrong for acute risk

message_feature: Whether the message gendered the content, and whether it merely addresses or actively regulates the group
perceived_social_meaning: 'Is this for me?' versus 'Why is my manhood being brought into this?'
appraisal: Self-categorisation OR identity-proposition evaluation
psychological_mechanism: Relevance and belonging OR added identity work
emotional_response: Recognition OR irritation, embarrassment, stereotype rejection
relational_response: Communicator seen as knowing the audience OR as pandering/policing
behavioural_possibility: Attention and relevance OR disengagement and mockery
key_moderators: Prior gender-coding of the behaviour; identity centrality; public visibility; descriptive vs prescriptive form
male_specificity_class: MALE-DIFFERENTIATED (moderated by identity, not by sex)
failure_mode: Backfires whenever gender is added to content that had no gender problem - it manufactures a negotiation that did not exist

message_feature: Language that treats the recipient as a competent adult with obligations to others rather than a deficient patient
perceived_social_meaning: 'Coming here does not cost me standing; it may even be part of what I owe people'
appraisal: Status and dignity appraisal; role congruence
psychological_mechanism: Preserved wibawa/harga diri; care reframed as responsibility discharged rather than weakness admitted
emotional_response: Dignity; sometimes pride; relief from shame
relational_response: Communicator treated as a respectful equal or credible authority
behavioural_possibility: Willingness to be seen engaging
key_moderators: Whether provider identity is currently intact or currently failing; economic precarity intensifies both directions
failure_mode: Backfires by RE-ANCHORING worth to provision: for a man who cannot provide, 'be a good provider' language is exactly the wrong frame (Man Box provider-failure ideation data)

message_feature: Who is speaking, and whether the relationship they claim is one the audience recognises
perceived_social_meaning: 'Is this person allowed to talk to me this way?'
appraisal: Source evaluation; register licensing; membership check
emotional_response: Trust and ease OR cringe, embarrassment, cynicism
relational_response: The entire relationship is set here before content is processed
behavioural_possibility: Everything downstream depends on it
key_moderators: Whether the speaker has real membership; regional and class coding of the register; institutional role
male_specificity_class: INDONESIA-CONFIGURED (pronoun system makes this unusually explicit)
failure_mode: Backfires instantly as fake slang. In Indonesian, gue/lo from an unlicensed institutional speaker is a credibility event, not a stylistic choice

message_feature: Concrete, falsifiable, costly commitments vs abstract values language
perceived_social_meaning: 'Why is this organisation saying this to me, and what has it actually done?'
appraisal: Persuasion-knowledge activation; covariation reasoning about motive
emotional_response: Respect OR cynicism and do-gooder derogation
relational_response: Long-run institutional trust
behavioural_possibility: Donation, referral, sustained relationship
key_moderators: Sender type (nonprofit baseline differs from commercial); consistency over time; cause-mission fit
failure_mode: Backfires most severely when a congruent promise is made and then not kept - worse than never promising

message_feature: Framing care as something that moves between people rather than something an individual procures
perceived_social_meaning: 'This fits how care already happens in my household'
appraisal: Role congruence within an existing division of care labour
psychological_mechanism: Care obtained without the man having to become an individual help-seeker
emotional_response: Relief; continuity; absence of role rupture
relational_response: Communicator recognised as understanding local life
behavioural_possibility: Care actually reaches the man, possibly via a wife, friend or neighbour
key_moderators: Household composition; whether relations are supportive or controlling; unmarried men are structurally exposed
failure_mode: Backfires by assuming every man has healthy relations; relationality is not a cure, and dependence can silence as easily as support

message_feature: Any framing that increases communal visibility of a man's distress
perceived_social_meaning: 'Who else will know, and what will they conclude about my family?'
appraisal: Family-stigma appraisal; rukun and gotong royong obligation
psychological_mechanism: Support mobilised OR reputational exposure incurred
emotional_response: Safety OR malu and family shame
relational_response: Community becomes an agent, not a backdrop
behavioural_possibility: Help arrives through neighbours OR concealment intensifies
key_moderators: Whether the specific community is a supportive or judging one; urban anonymity vs kampung visibility
failure_mode: The single most important Indonesian design constraint: every gain in communal reach is also a gain in communal exposure

message_feature: Whether distress is framed as fixed fate (takdir) or as a trial to be actively worked through (ngelakoni)
perceived_social_meaning: 'Is this something to be endured because it is written, or something I am responsible for managing?'
appraisal: Explanatory-model selection; positive vs negative religious coping
psychological_mechanism: Fatalism OR active coping with religious legitimacy
emotional_response: Resignation OR purposeful endurance
relational_response: Communicator aligned with or against the recipient's moral world
behavioural_possibility: Delayed care OR treatment adherence as religious duty
key_moderators: Which framing the surrounding community endorses; denomination; whether the organisation has standing to speak religiously
failure_mode: Backfires if a secular organisation appropriates religious authority it does not hold, or if it treats religiosity as an obstacle rather than a resource

message_feature: Any communication that assumes an accessible service exists
perceived_social_meaning: 'Even if I want this, can I get it, afford it, and reach it?'
appraisal: Feasibility appraisal (prior to and independent of persuasion)
emotional_response: Frustration; futility; cynicism about the organisation
relational_response: Credibility collapses if the promised pathway does not work
behavioural_possibility: Nothing happens regardless of message quality
key_moderators: JKN coverage; distance; queue length; consultation length; GP gatekeeping; cost of travel
failure_mode: This is the mechanism most likely to make an otherwise excellent voice strategy fail. A CTA without a working pathway is the corpus's clearest anti-pattern

message_feature: Irony, understatement, self-deprecation, absurdity
perceived_social_meaning: 'This is not solemn; I can approach without ceremony'
appraisal: Threat de-escalation; institutional distance reduction
emotional_response: Amusement; ease; reduced dread
relational_response: Communicator becomes peer-like
behavioural_possibility: Attention and entry, NOT demonstrated persuasion
key_moderators: Severity; whose joke it is; whether the group's humour norms are inclusive or exclusionary
failure_mode: Backfires when the social function is to make the subject undiscussable (banter as avoidance) or when it trivialises acute risk

message_feature: Scales, thresholds, streaks, simple numbers
perceived_social_meaning: 'I can locate myself without having to describe myself'
appraisal: Self-assessment without affective vocabulary
emotional_response: Calm; sometimes relief at not having to find words
relational_response: Communicator seen as practical
behavioural_possibility: Repeat self-monitoring; easier disclosure
key_moderators: Whether the metric measures something the person can influence; whether ranking is against self or others
failure_mode: Backfires as self-objectification when the metric is a comparative rank against other men (looksmaxxing) rather than a self-referenced state

message_feature: Content optimised for reach vs content optimised for conversion
perceived_social_meaning: (operates below awareness)
appraisal: n/a - system-level
psychological_mechanism: Exposure changes independently of message quality
emotional_response: Outrage begets outrage; visible virality increases outrage expression
relational_response: Audience composition shifts away from the intended audience
behavioural_possibility: Engagement metrics become endogenous and unreliable
key_moderators: Platform architecture; format; comment-driven reach
failure_mode: Constrains measurement, not just tone: high engagement can indicate hostility or algorithmic selection rather than agreement

message_feature: Proportion and forcefulness of moral content within a message
perceived_social_meaning: 'Are they telling me something, or telling me off?'
appraisal: Informational-utility appraisal; sanctimony detection
emotional_response: Moral elevation OR irritation and disengagement
relational_response: Institution seen as principled OR as grandstanding
behavioural_possibility: Sharing OR scrolling past
key_moderators: Sender type (a men's mental-health nonprofit has a higher licit moral baseline than a razor brand); issue; platform
evidence_strength: MODERATE for non-linearity; VERY WEAK for any number
failure_mode: Backfires as moral scolding. Never use a numeric density target; the operative variables are proportion of the message, imperative force, and whether the audience is positioned as culprit

message_feature: Whether an explanation leaves room for change
perceived_social_meaning: 'Does this explanation still let me do something?'
appraisal: Controllability appraisal
emotional_response: Hope OR despair
relational_response: Communicator seen as on the recipient's side OR as confirming his worst reading
behavioural_possibility: Continued engagement OR withdrawal
key_moderators: Severity; how much of the causation is genuinely structural; the recipient's prior attempts
failure_mode: Backfires in both directions: false hope ('just be disciplined') and fatalistic honesty ('the system is rigged') both foreclose action

message_feature: Independent settings for emotional explicitness and behavioural explicitness
perceived_social_meaning: 'How much do I have to feel out loud in order to use this?'
appraisal: Exposure appraisal separate from comprehension
emotional_response: Ease; and later, the possibility of emotion arriving on its own terms
relational_response: Communicator does not demand a performance as entry price
behavioural_possibility: Entry, then possible deepening
key_moderators: Stage of the relationship; severity; audience visibility; whether precision is clinically necessary
failure_mode: Backfires as euphemism when clinical precision is required (suicide risk, diagnosis, emergency instruction)
